title: Whole Upright Overlapping-Petal Cup Tulip
description: One newly authored whole static stylised tulip-like above-ground plant. One gently bowed full stem and two broad upward-curving clasping leaves support a deep upright flower cup formed by six separately thick overlapping petals. Each petal rises from the small green receptacle, swells outward along its middle and turns slightly inward to a rounded free upper lip; the open centre is between the actual petal walls, not a solid painted disk. No separate projecting trumpet or long central column. Entire new stem, broad wrapped leaf and curved cup petal coordinates, not old daffodil corona resized or hibiscus petals counted/recoloured. One plant model zero scenes. Static decorative exterior only; no exact species, stamens/pollen microdetail, roots, growth, pollination, cultivation, toxicity or biological function claim.
